title: Judge blocks FCC review of ABC station licenses for now
summary: The Walt Disney Co. secured a temporary restraining order Wednesday blocking the Federal Communications Commission from moving forward with an unusually early review of ABC’s broadcast-station licenses, which the media company has called an attack on free speech by the Trump administration.

title: Iowa residents mark Thanksgiving with lingering fears after chemical detonation
summary: The U.S. Army blew up the nation’s entire stockpile of lead azide, a chemical used to make explosives, saying the first checks show Wednesday’s controlled detonation in Iowa didn’t spread toxic dust to nearby homes and farms.

title: Pregnant inmate escapes from New Mexico corrections facility
summary: Authorities are searching for a pregnant inmate who escaped from a New Mexico corrections facility on Wednesday.

title: Hundreds of flights canceled on Thanksgiving Day as storms hit and question swirl over Iowa detonation: Morning Rundown
summary: Bad weather postpones the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade for the first-time ever.

title: Families navigate Thanksgiving after toxic chemical detonation
summary: In and around Middletown, Iowa, residents are navigating the Thanksgiving holiday after the U.S. Army detonated tons of toxic chemicals in the region. And while officials say no airborne lead has been detected, some families are still concerned. NBC News’ Shaquille Brewster reports.

title: Macy’s parade postponed over powerful storm
summary: Macy’s officially pressing pause on its iconic Thanksgiving Day Parade, now postponed to Saturday with a powerful storm closing in. NBC News’ Jesse Kirsch reports.

title: Performers and marching bands scramble after Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade delay
summary: After the historic decision to postpone the 100th Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade, performers and entire marching bands were forced to scramble to find ways to stay in the New York City area in order to perform during the new parade date on Saturday. NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin reports.

title: Thanksgiving Day parade celebrates 100 years
summary: With the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day parade now happening days after it was scheduled, rain or shine it is marking 100 years with what is planned to be the biggest parade in their history. NBC News’ Stephanie Gosk has the story.

title: Tons of toxic chemicals detonate in Iowa
summary: Two plumes filled the sky after the Army detonated nearly five tons of bomb-making material. The blast could be felt for miles. There’s no airborne lead detected throughout the region and the EPA says they’ll continue to test the air, soil and water. NBC News’ Shaquille Brewster has the story.

title: Questions linger about lead pollution from Iowa blast, despite officials’ assurances
summary: Scientists and Iowa residents said questions remain about how much contamination the Army’s detonation of lead azide caused, though they were hopeful about the initial results.

title: Black Friday deals are here, and they’re actually really good — I’m tracking the best ones live
summary: Shop Black Friday 2026 deals on tech, home, kitchen, beauty, fashion and more. NBC Selected editors reviewed thousands of discounts to find top-rated products and standout savings worth shopping now.

title: Why more American tech startups are ditching Silicon Valley for China’s Shenzhen
summary: In the intense world of startup technology, several American companies have opted against Silicon Valley and chosen the Chinese megacity of Shenzhen.

title: Children’s Hospital Throws Thanksgiving Parade for Patients
summary: Doctors, nurses and staffers at New York-Presbyterian Morgan Stanley Children’s Hospital got an early start to the Thanksgiving holiday spirit. They threw a special parade complete with floats, balloons and costumes all chosen and designed by patients themselves. TODAY’s Laura Jarrett shares the Morning Boost.

title: Hawai’i All-State Marching Band on Macy’s Parade Postponement
summary: With the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade postponed until Saturday, members of the Na Koa Ali’i Hawai’i All-State Marching Band join TODAY to discuss having their dream of playing now up in the air after months of fundraising and practice.

title: US Troops in Poland Get a Taste of Thanksgiving
summary: Under the frozen skies of northern Poland, American troops are running combat drills, training to perform under pressure in cramped cabins and assembling the communications antennas that are so critical to modern warfare. Although the troops can’t make it home, the military does its best to bring the Thanksgiving holiday to them. NBC’s Raf Sanchez reports for TODAY.

title: Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade Postponed for First Time Ever
summary: For the first time in its 100-year history, the world-famous Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade has been postponed. The unprecedented decision by Macy’s and New York City was made after forecasters warned of potentially dangerous storm conditions. NBC’s Erin McLaughlin reports for TODAY.

title: Aaron Rodgers Released by Pittsburgh Steelers Amid Public Feud
summary: The Pittsburgh Steelers released quarterback Aaron Rodgers, hours after he blasted the team’s head coach Mike McCarthy during a surprise appearance on “The Pat McAfee Show.” NBC’s Ryan Chandler reports for TODAY.

title: Thanksgiving travelers face long airport lines and packed roads
summary: Thousands of flights are canceled or delayed because of storms on one of the busiest travel days of the year. On the roads, families are ending up in standstill traffic.

title: Trump Administration Defends Iowa Detonation, Unveils New Tariffs
summary: The White House is calling the controversial detonation of old explosives in Iowa a success, saying there is no health impact. This comes as the Trump administration reignites fears over a new trade war, proposing sweeping tariffs targeting 11 countries, the European Union and China. NBC’s Kelly O’Donnell reports for TODAY.
